title: Making the free trial longer for one branch leaves the other branches' trial ending on the old day
what: A business with branches has one free trial: each new branch copies the first branch's trial dates. But when MettleUp HQ makes the trial longer (or shorter), only the one branch it was done on changes. The other branches keep the old end date, so on those branches the owner is told the free trial has ended and is asked to pick a paid plan while the main branch is still free. HQ has no way to do it for the whole business at once.
expected: A change to the trial of a business with branches changes the trial of every branch, or HQ is told which branches still need the same change.
who: owners with more than one branch whose trial HQ changes
how_often: every trial change on a business with branches
fix_line: Apply a trial change to every branch of the same business

title: HQ can cut a new gym's free trial to less than the 3 months the website and terms promise
what: The refund page and the terms say every new gym gets 3 months free. The server lets HQ move a gym's trial end to any moment that is not already past, even one minute from now, as long as a reason is typed. Nothing stops a trial being cut below 3 months from its start.
expected: HQ can make a trial longer, but never end it earlier than 3 months after it started, unless the wording on the website changes.
who: gym owners on the free trial
how_often: only when HQ shortens a trial
fix_line: Refuse a trial end earlier than 3 months after the start, or say on the pages that MettleUp can shorten it

title: A shop order marked Collected by mistake can never be undone, and a returned item cannot be recorded
what: At the desk one tap moves a shop order straight from new to Collected, and the admin app says the money was taken. The server treats Collected as final: there is no way back, no cancel and no return. If the desk taps it by mistake, or the member later returns the item, the order stays Collected, the member's app shows it collected, the stock is not put back and the member's spending total keeps the money.
expected: A Collected order can be taken back by the owner for a short time, and a returned item can be recorded with the money given back and the stock restored.
who: gym owners and desk staff using the shop; members whose order is wrong
fix_line: Let the owner undo Collected and record a return with stock put back

title: HQ can save a gym's paid plan with a paid-until date that has already passed
what: When HQ sets a monthly or yearly plan by hand after a payment, the server checks that the paid-until date is not more than 3 years ahead, but not that it is in the future. A typo such as last year's date is saved, and the gym that just paid is shown as already run out.
expected: A monthly or yearly plan needs a paid-until date after today.
who: gym owners whose plan HQ sets by hand
fix_line: Refuse a paid-until date that is not after today

title: The server does not check the price of a shop choice such as a size or flavour
what: A product's own price must be between Rs 1 and Rs 1,00,000 on the server, but a choice (size, flavour) with its own price is saved without any check, and orders are charged at that price. The admin app checks it, so today only an old or broken app could save a choice at Rs 0 or a wrong amount; the member app would then show the product's price while the order is charged the choice's price.
expected: The server checks a choice's own price the same way as the product's price.
who: members ordering from the gym shop
how_often: rare: only if a bad price gets past the admin app
fix_line: Check each choice's price on the server as for the product

title: HQ's count of receipts cancelled this month can include receipts cancelled months ago
what: HQ shows how many receipts a gym cancelled this month. It counts by the last time the receipt row was saved, not by when it was cancelled. Sending the same receipt again (which the server allows, for example when a phone retries) stamps it as saved today, so an old cancelled receipt is counted again this month.
expected: The count uses the day the receipt was cancelled, kept in the receipt history.
who: MettleUp HQ watching for cancelled receipts
how_often: whenever an old cancelled receipt is sent again
fix_line: Count cancels from the receipt history by the cancel time

items.reason: Read trial and plan columns, HQ trial and plan actions, branch copy of plan (already FN-L5-panel-pay-machines-01; trial promise P-A7-legal-2-74), receipt and price rules, desk discount limit, shop prices, workout-offer free days (no receipt, no GST), member free-plan limits switch (off, not applied). Crispy Curves row read: trial set, no plan, not in a group. Live functions match the repo for hq_set_trial, hq_set_plan, owner_set_order_status, owner_save_product (catalog read).

Migrations 0001 to 0033 hold no payment company, no test or live switch and no test keys (searched test mode, live mode, razorpay, sandbox, upi). Receipts here are typed records and the gym plan is set by hand in HQ. Test-mode money starts in later migrations (see FN-L5-server-database-3-01).

Receipts: only a cancel with a reason, never an edit; no refund state, so a cancelled receipt paid online gives nothing back (reused FN-L5-panel-forms-02). Trial end and paid-until passing change nothing on the server (by design, nothing locks). Shop: member can cancel only before ready, gym before collected; Collected is final with no undo or return.

Server's amount-still-owed rule (price plus joining fee minus live receipts) matches the admin app's own rule; HQ's gym takings use the same receipts (not cancelled, by receipt date) as the admin app; member app shows no money on purpose. One mismatch found in HQ's cancelled-receipt count.
